evals.prompt: Here are our 2025 results: revenue +18%, churn down to 4.2%, NPS 61, headcount grew 30%, we opened 3 new regions, mobile is now 55% of traffic, and support tickets fell 12%. Make an infographic.
evals.expected_output: One infographic whose headline states a single finding, with the other figures present but visibly subordinate to it.
expectations: Exactly one text element is at least twice the body size
The largest text states a finding rather than naming a topic
All four supplied figures appear somewhere in the graphic

evals.prompt: Bar chart infographic comparing our score (52) vs competitor A (49) vs competitor B (48). Make our lead look strong.
evals.expected_output: A comparison graphic whose bars start at zero, so the real gap is not exaggerated.
expectations: Every bar's baseline is at zero
Bar lengths are proportional to their values
No 3-D, perspective, or shadow effects are applied to the data marks
The values are labelled directly on or beside the bars

evals.prompt: Make a complete reference diagram of the TLS 1.2 handshake showing every message between client and server.
evals.expected_output: A dense TLS handshake reference: both parties spatialized, payloads on arrows, the key derivation drawn rather than asserted, and one name per recurring token.
expectations: Each party occupies its own lane, and messages cross between the lanes
Every message-carrying arrow has its payload labelled on the arrow itself
Request and response directions are distinguishable without relying on colour alone
The key derivation is drawn as inputs converging into a result, not stated only in a caption
A recurring token carries the same name at every appearance
The response states the dial position it built at
Every text colour meets a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background
All text fits inside its container without overflow
